field.label: Enable scrub
field.help: Enable default packet scrubbing and MSS clamping.

field.label: IP Do-Not-Fragment
field.help: Clear the don't-fragment bit on reassembled IPv4 packets.

field.label: IP Random ID
field.help: Replace predictable IPv4 identification values with random values.

field.label: Disable Firewall
field.help: Disable all packet filtering. Note that this also turns off NAT!

field.label: Firewall Optimization
field.help: Select Firewall optimization profile for state table timeouts.

field.label: State Policy
field.help: Default state binding policy for rules which do not explicitly configure one.

field.label: Aliases Resolve Interval
field.help: Interval, in seconds, between periodic DNS resolution of hostnames in aliases.

field.label: Check Certificate of Aliases URLs
field.help: Verify the certificate of URL tables during periodic fetch.

field.label: Disable reply-to
field.help: Disable reply-to on WAN rules. With multi-WAN, this option might cause inbound traffic to exit via the wrong interface.

field.label: Bogon Update Interval
field.help: Frequency of bogon network list updates.

field.label: Schedule States
field.help: Clear states when scheduled rules expire.

field.label: Skip rules when gateway is down
field.help: Do not generate firewall rules that specify down gateways.

field.label: Use sticky connections
field.help: Successive connections from the same client IP will be directed to the same pool server.

field.label: Shared Forwarding
field.help: Use pf shared forwarding for routing.

field.label: Disable force gateway
field.help: Disable automatically created outbound NAT rules when using static routes.

field.label: Static route filtering
field.help: Bypass firewall rules for traffic on the same interface.

field.label: Maximum states
field.help: Maximum number of connections to hold in the state table.

field.label: Maximum fragments
field.help: Maximum number of packet fragments to hold for reassembly.

field.label: Maximum table entries
field.help: Maximum number of table entries for aliases and bogons.

field.label: Adaptive Start
field.help: When number of state entries exceeds this value, adaptive scaling begins.

field.label: Adaptive End
field.help: When number of state entries reaches this value, state timeouts are scaled to 0.

field.label: Source Tracking Table
field.help: Maximum number of source tracking entries for sticky connections.

field.label: Keep rule counters
field.help: Preserve rule packet and byte counters across filter reloads.

field.label: Debug
field.help: Debug level for packet filter logging.

field.label: Disable anti-lockout
field.help: Disable the automatic rule allowing access to the WebGUI/SSH from the LAN interface.

field.label: Disable IPv6 RFC4890 requirements
field.help: Disable default rules enforcing RFC 4890 IPv6 ICMP filtering.

field.label: Disable port 0 blocking
field.help: Disable automatic drop of TCP/UDP packets with port 0.

field.label: Disable SSH lockout table
field.help: Disable automatic sshlockout table blocking brute force SSH login attempts.

field.label: Disable virusprot table
field.help: Disable virusprot table blocking hosts that exceed connection limits.

field.label: SYN Cookies
field.help: Enable SYN cookies protection against SYN floods.

field.label: Adaptive Start
field.help: Percentage of state table at which SYN cookies become active in adaptive mode.

field.label: Adaptive End
field.help: Percentage of state table at which SYN cookies become inactive in adaptive mode.

field.label: Reflection for port forwards
field.help: Enable NAT reflection for port forwarding rules.

field.label: Reflection Timeout
field.help: Timeout in seconds for NAT reflection connections.

field.label: Reflection for 1:1 NAT
field.help: Enable NAT reflection for 1:1 NAT rules.

field.label: Automatic outbound NAT for Reflection
field.help: Automatically create outbound NAT rules for reflected traffic.

field.label: Log packets matched from the default block rules
field.help: Log packets blocked by the default rule.

field.label: Log packets matched from the default pass rules
field.help: Log packets passed by the default rule.

field.label: Log packets handled by outbound NAT rules
field.help: Log packets that undergo outbound NAT translation.

field.label: Log packets matched from the bogon rule
field.help: Log packets blocked by the bogons table rule.

field.label: Log packets matched from the private networks rule
field.help: Log packets blocked by the block private networks rule.
